C-FIX-015-TABLE-EXPORT-INTEGRITY.Name: Preserve table data during Markdown export
C-FIX-015-TABLE-EXPORT-INTEGRITY.Summary: Make table Markdown export lossless for cell-leading pipes and total for ragged rows. Unescaped pipes at any position become escaped exactly once; missing cells become empty cells rather than exceptions or the text undefined.
C-FIX-015-TABLE-EXPORT-INTEGRITY.Problem: Risk-28 records that the current regex misses a pipe at index zero. Risk-29 records irregular-row export as unsafe because width calculation dereferences missing cells.
C-FIX-015-TABLE-EXPORT-INTEGRITY.ApprovalBasis: The owner instructed the standard GRACE plan, verification and two-clean-review workflow for the agreed post-2.6 stabilization boundary on 2026-10-20.

Goals.Goal: Escape each structurally significant pipe while preserving already escaped pipes.
Normalize ragged header/body geometry to a rectangular Markdown table with empty synthesized cells.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve alignment markers, indentation and ordinary regular-table byte shape.
No parser rewrite or table editing/UI change.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No nested-list, empty-table-delete, IME, performance, release or platform work.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Leading, middle and even-backslash-preceded unescaped pipes are escaped; already escaped pipes are not double escaped.
Rows shorter or longer than the header export without throwing, retain all real cells, synthesize blanks, and never emit undefined.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Direct exporter fixtures cover pipe parity, missing cells, extra cells, alignment and regular output.

Assumptions.Assumption: Table metadata row/column values are advisory; actual header/body cell arrays are the source of truth and the widest observed row defines preserved geometry.
